prerequisites: Has a basic knowledge about the metallurgical process of metal ores and receiving ferrous alloys and non-ferrous metals; Has a basic knowledge about the types of engineering materials - their properties, applications and principles of their selection; Has a basic knowledge about the structure of metals and alloys as well as the principles of their classification and labeling;

Can determine the characteristics of the materials microstructure, identify occurring in material phases; Also is able to differentiate: the microstructure of ferrous alloys (in terms of carbon content), non-ferrous alloys and the effect of the heat treatment;
Can read and interpret the figures and diagrams used in the technical documentation;

learning_outcomes.text: Has a basic knowledge of the manual and machine manufacturing technologies of foundry molds and cores
Has a knowledge of the basic methods of melting and treatment of metallurgical alloys.

Has a basic knowledge about designing the casting products and the processes for their production with principles of technology of their selection dependent on the type of casting and the type of alloy.
Can analyze and design the process of production casting equipment to a simple product.
Can choose the right technology for casting and define the basic parameters of that process.
Can choose the right method of treatment of the casting alloy and define its basic parameters.
Can search for information and critically analyze them, rationally explain them and justify the own point of view using the knowledge of foundry branch.
Recognizes the importance of team cooperation on ways to choose a strategy to optimally solve assigned to a group problems.
Understands the need to respect the traditions and rules in academia and society.

syllabus_topics: Organizational issues. Discussion about the specific shape of the state from the liquid metal, fundamental concepts and algorithms for casting production.
Principles for design and construction of casting equipment.
Materials and equipment used for the preparation of the molding and core sands and the methods of their manufacturing and testing their properties.
Methods for manual manufacturing of foundry molds and cores.
Automatic manufacturing of foundry molds and cores.
Production of molds and cores from selfsetting molding sands.
Production of molds and cores from thermosetting molding sands.
Manufacturing the castings using a precise technique of lost models.
Knocking out and the cleaning of castings.
Manufacturing the castings in metal molds.
Metallurgical treatment of casting alloys and heat treatment of castings. Knowledge test.
Organizational issues. Research the materials and molding sands.
Construction of casting models and core boxes.
Manual production of foundry molds and cores.
Automatic production of foundry molds and cores.
Production of molds and cores from self- and thermosetting molding sands.
Manufacturing the castings in metal molds.
Testing the properties of casting alloys. Completion of the course.
teaching_methods: traditional lecture with the use of transparencies and slides
self study - preparation for laboratory class
self study - self studies and preparation for examination
assessment_rules: For the lecture part, the concluding evaluation (P) is equal to the formative evaluation (F1) from the colloquium. For the laboratory part, the concluding evaluation (P) is the average of all grades (F1, F2, F3) from short exams, oral exams, and laboratory reports.
